revisions.owner_action: Settings -> Developer -> Boot: toggle Verbose boot on, then reboot once and confirm the boot log appears on the glass before the launcher; disable it again. The one-time Bixby-hold override is BLOCKED_KERNEL/BOOT_UPDATE_REQUIRED and cannot be tested (docs/beta-finalization/manual-proof/03-display-boot.md step 5)
revisions.note: Durable setting at /etc/nuxel/boot/verbose-boot.json (shipped default in configs/nuxel/boot/verbose-boot.json), installed with the 'keep' upgrade rule and merged on every write so a package update can never clobber a user decision; legacy flags migrated once. Honoured by the early userspace stage (nuxel-verbose-boot.service -> nuxel-verbose-boot.py), toggleable from the Quick Settings tile and the Settings app, and wired into 'nuxelctl verbose-boot status|on|off|override'. The one-time Bixby-hold override is implemented but the installed early boot stage cannot read the Bixby key state, so it is honestly reported as BLOCKED_KERNEL / BOOT_UPDATE_REQUIRED and REFUSED rather than faked behind a cosmetic switch. On-glass effect remains NEEDS_OWNER_TEST.
